fields.name: entity
fields.doc: Camera, light or other entity whose local -Z axis should face the target.

fields.name: point
fields.doc: World-space target position. Supply exactly one of point or target.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: Target entity in this document; its world position is used.

fields.name: up
fields.doc: Preferred world-space up vector; defaults to +Y. At a pole a stable perpendicular axis is used.
